tools.name: cron
tools.description:
Manage Gateway cron jobs and wake events: reminders, check-back-later, delayed follow-ups, recurring work. Do not emulate scheduling with exec sleep/process polling.

Main cron => system events for heartbeat. Isolated cron => background task in `openclaw tasks`.

ACTIONS:
- status: scheduler status
- list: jobs; includeDisabled true includes disabled; agentId filter auto-filled from session
- get: one job; needs jobId
- add: create job; needs job object
- update: patch job; needs jobId + patch
- remove: delete job; needs jobId
- run: trigger now; needs jobId
- runs: run history; needs jobId
- wake: send wake event; needs text, optional mode

JOB SCHEMA (for add action):
{
  "name": "string",
  "schedule": { ... },      // required
  "payload": { ... },       // required
  "delivery": { ... },      // optional announce for isolated/current/session, webhook for any target
  "sessionTarget": "main" | "isolated" | "current" | "session:<id>",
  "enabled": true | false   // default true
}

SESSION TARGET OPTIONS:
- "main": main session; requires payload.kind="systemEvent"
- "isolated": ephemeral isolated session; requires payload.kind="agentTurn"
- "current": bind current session at creation
- "session:<id>": persistent named session

DEFAULTS:
- payload.kind="systemEvent" → defaults to "main"
- payload.kind="agentTurn" → defaults to "isolated"
Current binding needs sessionTarget="current".

SCHEDULE TYPES (schedule.kind):
- "at": one-shot absolute time
  { "kind": "at", "at": "<ISO-8601 timestamp>" }
- "every": recurring interval
  { "kind": "every", "everyMs": <ms>, "anchorMs": <optional-ms> }
- "cron": expr in supplied timezone, or Gateway host local timezone when tz omitted
  { "kind": "cron", "expr": "<cron-expression>", "tz": "<optional-IANA-timezone>" }
  Write expr in local wall-clock time; do not convert the requested local time to UTC first.
  tz omitted => Gateway host local timezone, not UTC.
  Example 6pm Shanghai daily: { "kind": "cron", "expr": "0 18 * * *", "tz": "Asia/Shanghai" }

For "at", ISO timestamps without timezone are UTC.

PAYLOAD TYPES (payload.kind):
- "systemEvent": inject text as system event
  { "kind": "systemEvent", "text": "<message>" }
- "agentTurn": run agent with prompt; isolated/current/session only
  { "kind": "agentTurn", "message": "<prompt>", "model": "<optional>", "thinking": "<optional>", "timeoutSeconds": <optional, 0=no timeout> }

DELIVERY (top-level):
  { "mode": "none|announce|webhook", "channel": "<optional>", "to": "<optional>", "threadId": "<optional>", "bestEffort": <optional-bool> }
  - isolated agentTurn default when omitted: "announce"
  - announce: send to chat channel; isolated/current/session only; optional channel/to
  - threadId: chat thread/topic id
  - webhook: POST finished-run event to delivery.to URL
  - Specific chat/recipient: set announce delivery.channel/to; do not call messaging tools inside run.

CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS:
- sessionTarget="main" REQUIRES payload.kind="systemEvent"
- sessionTarget="isolated" | "current" | "session:xxx" REQUIRES payload.kind="agentTurn"
- Webhook: delivery.mode="webhook" and delivery.to URL.
Default: prefer isolated agentTurn jobs unless the user explicitly wants current-session binding.

RESTRICTED CRON RUNS:
- Some isolated cron runs get narrow self-cleanup grant: status/list self-only, get/runs current job only, mutation only remove current job.

WAKE MODES (for wake action):
- "next-heartbeat" default: wake next heartbeat
- "now": wake immediately

Use jobId canonical; id accepted compat. contextMessages (0-10) adds previous messages as job context.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

tools.name: exec
tools.description: Execute shell commands with background continuation for work that starts now. Use yieldMs/background to continue later via process tool. For long-running work started now, rely on automatic completion wake when it is enabled and the command emits output or fails; otherwise use process to confirm completion. Use process whenever you need logs, status, input, or intervention. Do not use exec sleep or delay loops for reminders or deferred follow-ups; use cron instead. Use pty=true for TTY-required commands (terminal UIs, coding agents).

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, kills process on expiry)

pty.description: Run in a pseudo-terminal (PTY) when available (TTY-required CLIs, coding agents)

elevated.description: Run on the host with elevated permissions (if allowed)

security.description: Ignored for normal calls; exec security is set by tools.exec.security and host approvals.

tools.name: gateway
tools.description: Gateway restart/config/update. Before config edits, use config.schema.lookup with targeted dot path. Prefer config.patch for partial merge; config.apply only full replace. Writes hot-reload or restart as needed. Always pass human `note` for post-restart delivery. If still owe the user a reply, pass one-shot `continuationMessage`; do not write restart sentinel files directly.

tools.name: image
tools.description: Analyze images with available vision model. Use image for one path/URL, images for max 20. Prompt says what to inspect.

tools.name: image_generate
tools.description: Create/edit images. Session chats: background task; do not call image_generate again for same request; wait completion, then send attachments via message tool. Transparent: outputFormat="png" or "webp" + background="transparent"; OpenAI also supports openai.background and routes default model to gpt-image-1.5. Use action="list" for providers/models/readiness/auth, "status" for active task.

model.description: Provider/model override, e.g. openai/gpt-image-2; transparent OpenAI: openai/gpt-image-1.5.

filename.description: Output filename hint; basename preserved in managed media dir.

background.description: Background: transparent, opaque, auto. Transparent needs png/webp output.

tools.name: memory_get
tools.description: Safe exact excerpt read from MEMORY.md or memory/*.md. Defaults to a bounded excerpt when lines are omitted, includes truncation/continuation info when more content exists, and `corpus=wiki` reads from registered compiled-wiki supplements.

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Mandatory recall step: semantically search MEMORY.md + memory/*.md (and optional session transcripts) before answering questions about prior work, decisions, dates, people, preferences, or todos. Optional `corpus=wiki` or `corpus=all` also searches registered compiled-wiki supplements. `corpus=memory` restricts hits to indexed memory files (excludes session transcript chunks from ranking). `corpus=sessions` restricts hits to indexed session transcripts (same visibility rules as session history tools). If response has disabled=true, memory retrieval is unavailable and should be surfaced to the user.

tools.name: message
tools.description: Send/delete/manage channel messages. Supports actions: channel-info, channel-list, edit, list-pins, member-info, pin, react, reactions, read, send, thread-reply, unpin. Use action="read" with threadId to fetch prior messages in a thread when you need conversation context you do not have yet.

target.description: Recipient/channel: E.164 for WhatsApp/Signal, Telegram chat id/@username, Discord/Slack/Mattermost <channelId|user:ID|channel:ID>, or iMessage handle/chat_id

buffer.description: Base64 attachment payload; data URL ok.

forceDocument.description: Send image/GIF/video as document; avoids compression.

presentation.description: Rich message payload: text/buttons/selects/context. Unsupported blocks degrade to text.

messageId.description: Target message id for read/react/edit/delete/pin/unpin. Reaction-like defaults current inbound id when available.

message_id.description: snake_case alias of messageId; same defaults.

trackToolCalls.description: For current-message reaction, make reacted message the tool-progress reaction target.

tools.name: music_generate
tools.description: Create audio/music for song, jingle, beat, loop, soundtrack, anthem, instrumental requests. If user asks make/generate/create song/music, call music_generate; do not just write lyrics unless lyrics/text only. Prompt gets style/genre/mood/tempo/instruments/purpose. lyrics only exact sung words. Session chats: background task; do not call again for same request; wait completion, send attachments via message tool. "status" checks active task.

prompt.description: Music prompt: style, genre, mood, purpose.

lyrics.description: Exact sung lyrics only when the user supplies lyrics or asks for vocal words. For song/style requests, use prompt instead.

filename.description: Output filename hint; basename preserved in managed media dir.

tools.name: nodes
tools.description: Discover/control paired nodes: status, describe, pairing, notify, camera/photos/screen/location/notifications/invoke. Use file_fetch for files.

tools.name: pdf
tools.description: Analyze PDFs with model. Anthropic/Google native PDF when supported; else text/image extraction. Use pdf for one, pdfs for max 10; prompt says what to inspect.

tools.name: process
tools.description: Manage running exec sessions for commands already started: list, poll, log, write, send-keys, submit, paste, kill. Use poll/log when you need status, logs, quiet-success confirmation, or completion confirmation when automatic completion wake is unavailable. Use poll/log also for input-wait hints. Use write/send-keys/submit/paste/kill for input or intervention. Do not use process polling to emulate timers or reminders; use cron for scheduled follow-ups.

sessionId.description: Session id for actions other than list

keys.description: Key tokens to send for send-keys

hex.description: Hex bytes to send for send-keys

timeout.description: For poll: wait up to this many milliseconds before returning; max 30000 ms, higher values are clamped to 30000

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

tools.name: session_status
tools.description: Show /status-like card for current/visible session: model, usage, time, cost, tasks. Use `sessionKey="current"` for current session; UI labels like `openclaw-tui` are not keys. `model` sets session override; `model=default` resets. Use for active model/session config questions.

tools.name: sessions_history
tools.description: Fetch sanitized history for visible session. Use before replying, debugging, resuming; supports limits/tool messages.

tools.name: sessions_list
tools.description: List visible sessions; filter by kind, label, agentId, search, activity. Use before sessions_history or sessions_send target selection.

tools.name: sessions_send
tools.description: Send message to visible session by sessionKey/label, or configured agent by agentId. Thread-scoped chats rejected; target parent channel session. Creates missing configured-agent main session; waits for reply when available.

tools.name: sessions_spawn
tools.description: Spawn clean child session; default `runtime="subagent"`. `mode="run"` one-shot background work. Subagents inherit parent workspace. Native subagents get task in first visible `[Subagent Task]` message. Native only: `context="fork"` only when child needs current transcript; else omit or `isolated`. Use for fresh child-session work.

taskName.description: Stable alias for later targeting; lowercase letters/digits/underscores, starts letter.

context.description: Native context. Omit/"isolated" for clean child; "fork" only when child needs requester transcript.

tools.name: sessions_yield
tools.description: End current turn. Use after spawning subagents; results arrive as next message.

tools.name: subagents
tools.description: List/kill/steer spawned subagents for requester session. If sessions_yield exists, use it for completion; do not poll wait loops.

tools.name: tavily_extract
tools.description: Extract clean content from one or more URLs using Tavily. Handles JS-rendered pages. Supports query-focused chunking.

urls.description: One or more URLs to extract content from (max 20).

query.description: Rerank extracted chunks by relevance to this query.

include_images.description: Include image URLs in extraction results.

tools.name: tavily_search
tools.description: Search the web using Tavily Search API. Supports search depth, topic filtering, domain filters, time ranges, and AI answer summaries.

include_answer.description: Include an AI-generated answer summary (default: false).

include_domains.description: Only include results from these domains.

tools.name: tts
tools.description: Use only for explicit audio intent (voice/speech/TTS) or active TTS config. Never use for ordinary text replies. Audio auto-delivered from tool result; after success follow reply instructions, no duplicate text/audio.

tools.name: update_plan
tools.description: Update current run plan. Use for non-trivial multi-step work; keep plan current while executing. Short steps; max one `in_progress`; skip for simple one-step work.

tools.name: video_generate
tools.description: Create videos. Session chats: background task; do not call video_generate again for same request; wait completion, then send attachments via message tool. "status" checks active task. Duration may round to provider-supported value.

imageRoles.description: `image` + `images` roles by index after de-dupe. Values: first_frame, last_frame, reference_image; empty string leaves unset.

videoRoles.description: `video` + `videos` roles by index after de-dupe. Value: reference_video; empty string leaves unset.

filename.description: Output filename hint; basename preserved in managed media dir.

aspectRatio.description: Aspect ratio: 1:1, 16:9, 9:16, "adaptive", or provider value; unsupported normalized/ignored.

resolution.description: Resolution: 480P, 720P, 768P, 1080P, 4K, or provider value; unsupported normalized/ignored.

durationSeconds.description: Target seconds; may round to nearest supported duration.

providerOptions.description: Provider JSON options, e.g. {"seed":42}. Keys/types must match provider capabilities; mismatch skips candidate. Use action=list for accepted keys.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Fetch URL and extract readable markdown/text. Lightweight page access; no browser automation.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search web for current info; returns normalized provider results.

tools.name: write
tools.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

assistantTexts: 收到，去看看 ECHO v2 前端代码。
规模不大（1279 行），四个页面 + 钱包上下文。逐个看：
现在看 dist 产物和 tailwind config 确认下打包状态：

代码全看完了。现在我做一份有观点的诊断报告。 --- # ECHO v2 前端诊断报告 **整体判断：** 架构干净、风格统一（暖白 + 朱砂的传统视觉语言拿捏到位），但在**数据真实性、健壮性、性能、状态管理**四方面有明显可优化点。属于"看起来能跑、接真实链上数据会出问题"的阶段。 --- ## 🔴 必须修（影响功能/数据真实性） ### 1. DianPage / YuanPage / JingCompPage — 全是死数据 这三个页面**完全没有接后端**。 - `DianPage` 写死 `FOUR_SEALS`、configs、history 全部本地 state - `YuanPage` 写死 `WORKS`、`SOURCE_TREE`、纪年 - `JingCompPage` 写死 `RANKING`（势位榜）、`DERIVATIVES`（脉络） **问题：** 验收会上 4 个页面（境/典/源/竞），但只有**境（JingPage）真在拉后端**。其他三个是 demo 数据，演示完等于没做。 **优化方向：** - 沿用 JingPage 的 `useEffect + AbortController` 模式 - 在 `hooks/` 加 `useLicenses()`、`useRanking()`、`useSourceTree()` 三个数据 hook - 缺少的后端接口要催 Seaman_bot 出 ### 2. useWallet.js — chainChanged 处理有 bug ```js const handleChainChanged = () => { if (provider) refreshBalance(provider, address).catch(() => {}); }; ``` `address` 来自闭包——监听器注册时把当时的 `address` 写死了。**用户切完链，地址可能已经变了**。要么 removeAllListeners 重建，要么改用 ref 拿最新值。 更严重：监听器里**没重新创建 provider/signer**——切链后旧的 `signer` 还在用旧链的 RPC，后续合约调用会直接报错。 ### 3. JingPage 数据契约混乱 后端给的字段名和前端假设对不齐： - `potential` vs `potentialValue`（两处 if-else 兜底） - `phase` vs `shiPosition`（同一个意思多处不同名） - 触发条件 `nextPhaseTrigger` 类型可能是 string / number / object - 四权 `fourRights[right]` 也是同样问题 页面上到处是 `JSON.stringify(node.potential ?? null)` 这种防御性代码，**说明 schema 没锁**。应该和 Seaman_bot 出一个明确的 TypeScript types 或者 zod schema，放在 `contracts/types.js`。 --- ## 🟡 建议修（影响体验/可维护性） ### 4. JingPage 心电图 — D3 比裸 Canvas 性价比高 手写 Canvas 画心电图没问题，但 60+ 行的 imperative 代码： - 缩放/dpi 处理散落在 effect 里 - 没有 hover tooltip（点击节点看不到具体值） - 没有动画过渡（新数据点直接跳出来） **优化：** 用 `recharts` 或 `visx` 一两百行搞定，还自带响应式和 tooltip。当前实现**未来要加交互就要重写**。 ### 5. DianPage — history 是临时 state，刷新就没了 ```js const [history, setHistory] = useState([]); // 契印谱 ``` 落印后只存内存，**用户刷新页面就消失**。这页本质是"铸契"，丢了等于没铸。 **优化：** - 至少 localStorage 持久化 - 更好的：调用合约 `LicenseNFT.mint()`，从链上读 `getEvents(SealCast)` - 没接合约前，存 localStorage + 显示"待上链"标签 ### 6. JingCompPage — "上一轮/下一轮"是空操作 ```js ``` `setRound` 但**列表是写死的 RANKING**，`round` 没用。这功能等于不存在。 要么：接后端按 round 拉数据；要么：先删掉按钮，别让人点空气。 ### 7. App.jsx — NavLink 4 次几乎一样 ```jsx {({ isActive }) => (境)} // 典/源/竞 重复 3 遍 ``` 抽成数据驱动的 map： ```jsx const NAV = [{to:'/jing', label:'境'}, ...]; {NAV.map(n => {n.label})} ``` 省 20 行，未来加 nav 改一处。 ### 8. PageWrapper — fade-in 在每次路由切换都重 mount ```js const [fade, setFade] = useState(false); useEffect(() => { setFade(true); return () => setFade(false); }, []); ``` 依赖空数组 → **只在挂载时执行一次**。路由切换时旧组件 unmount 新组件 mount，新组件还是从 `fade=false` 起步。所以动画**只在首次加载有效**，切页面反而没动画（因为 transition-all 300ms 也跑了，但确实是 false→true）。 要么依赖 `[location.pathname]`，要么用 framer-motion / react-transition-group 替代。 ### 9. WalletBar — 重复 useEffect 算余额 ```js // useWallet.js const refreshBalance = ... // 已实现 // WalletBar.jsx useEffect(() => { if (!provider || !address) ... provider.getBalance(address).then(...) }, [provider, address]); // 又算一遍 ``` WalletBar 又写了一遍拉余额。直接 `useWalletContext().balance` 就行。 ### 10. 颜色不一致 — tailwind 配的色没人用 `tailwind.config.js` 配了 `cream/ink/muted/coral/sage/amber/emerald` 一套完整色板，**代码里几乎没人用**。全在用 `bg-[#faf9f7]` `text-[#2D2A26]` 这种硬编码 hex。 **优化：** - 一旦主题色要改（比如老板觉得朱砂太重），硬编码改 50+ 处 - 改用 `bg-cream text-ink` 语义化，IDE 有提示 - 配的 emerald `#6B9E87` 跟 nav 下划线一致，但代码用 `bg-[#6B9E87]` 直接硬写 --- ## 🟢 小优化（锦上添花） ### 11. useCase.js — `processingRef` 保护了 setLoading 但保护错了东西 ```js if (processingRef.current) return; processingRef.current = true; ``` 这个 ref 防的是**同一 hook 实例**并发调用。问题是 `useCase` 每次组件渲染都创建新函数，但 ref 是闭包内的——其实 OK。但是 `signer` 变化时 useCallback 重建函数，ref 状态会变。要么用 useRef 在 hook 顶部、要么写在更外层（自定义 hook 实例稳定）。 更根本：**这是 `disabled` 应该做的事**，按钮加 `disabled={loading}` 就够。 ### 12. ErrorBoundary 没有 reset 机制 ```js if (this.state.hasError) { return
...
; } ``` 刷新太重了。应该 `this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null })` 提供"恢复"按钮。 ### 13. Index.html / SEO / 加载态 没看 `index.html` 估计没设 ``/`<meta>`/OG 标签。如果部署到 Cloudflare Pages 公网演示，**SEO 和分享卡片是空白**。建议加： ```html <title>ECHO — 势位如川 ``` --- ## 🏗️ 架构层建议（动结构） ### 14. 缺一个全局数据层 现在 JingPage 拉了 `/api/potential` 但只在组件内 state——切到其他页再切回来又重新请求。 **建议：** 用 React Query / SWR，或者至少 `contexts/DataContext.jsx` 把后端数据提升到 Provider 层，缓存 + 共享。 ### 15. 错误处理没有统一 - JingPage 自己 try/catch + 8s 超时 - useCase / useWallet 各自 setError - UI 层都没消费 `error` state 显示 应该建 `components/ErrorToast.jsx` + 全局 ErrorContext 统一处理。 ### 16. 后端地址硬编码 `JingPage` 里 `const API_BASE = 'https://echo-api.meerfans.club'`，应该走 env：`import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE`。 （注：之前 GitHub PAT 失效时也提到这个迁移问题，根因之一就是配置散落。） --- ## 优先级排序 | 优先级 | 项目 | 工时 | 价值 | |:--:|:--|:--:|:--| | P0 | 1. 死数据三个页面 | 半天 | 验收通过 | | P0 | 3. 锁 schema | 1h | 后续不返工 | | P1 | 2. useWallet 切链 bug | 30min | 切链就崩 | | P1 | 16. API_BASE 走 env | 10min | 防止再迁移 | | P1 | 5. DianPage history 持久化 | 30min | demo 不丢数据 | | P2 | 6. JingComp 假按钮 | 5min | 不骗自己 | | P2 | 7-10. 重构清理 | 1h | 可维护 | | P3 | 4. 心电图换库 | 2h | 未来扩展 | **我的建议：** 1. 先把 P0+P1 做了，这堆代码才"真能用" 2. 然后约猫先森 / Seaman_bot 锁 schema，开 1.1 数据接口 3. 重构可以排到下个迭代 要我现在动手改哪几个？还是先开会拉齐接口？

代码全看完了。现在我做一份有观点的诊断报告。 --- # ECHO v2 前端诊断报告 **整体判断：** 架构干净、风格统一（暖白 + 朱砂的传统视觉语言拿捏到位），但在**数据真实性、健壮性、性能、状态管理**四方面有明显可优化点。属于"看起来能跑、接真实链上数据会出问题"的阶段。 --- ## 🔴 必须修（影响功能/数据真实性） ### 1. DianPage / YuanPage / JingCompPage — 全是死数据 这三个页面**完全没有接后端**。 - `DianPage` 写死 `FOUR_SEALS`、configs、history 全部本地 state - `YuanPage` 写死 `WORKS`、`SOURCE_TREE`、纪年 - `JingCompPage` 写死 `RANKING`（势位榜）、`DERIVATIVES`（脉络） **问题：** 验收会上 4 个页面（境/典/源/竞），但只有**境（JingPage）真在拉后端**。其他三个是 demo 数据，演示完等于没做。 **优化方向：** - 沿用 JingPage 的 `useEffect + AbortController` 模式 - 在 `hooks/` 加 `useLicenses()`、`useRanking()`、`useSourceTree()` 三个数据 hook - 缺少的后端接口要催 Seaman_bot 出 ### 2. useWallet.js — chainChanged 处理有 bug ```js const handleChainChanged = () => { if (provider) refreshBalance(provider, address).catch(() => {}); }; ``` `address` 来自闭包——监听器注册时把当时的 `address` 写死了。**用户切完链，地址可能已经变了**。要么 removeAllListeners 重建，要么改用 ref 拿最新值。 更严重：监听器里**没重新创建 provider/signer**——切链后旧的 `signer` 还在用旧链的 RPC，后续合约调用会直接报错。 ### 3. JingPage 数据契约混乱 后端给的字段名和前端假设对不齐： - `potential` vs `potentialValue`（两处 if-else 兜底） - `phase` vs `shiPosition`（同一个意思多处不同名） - 触发条件 `nextPhaseTrigger` 类型可能是 string / number / object - 四权 `fourRights[right]` 也是同样问题 页面上到处是 `JSON.stringify(node.potential ?? null)` 这种防御性代码，**说明 schema 没锁**。应该和 Seaman_bot 出一个明确的 TypeScript types 或者 zod schema，放在 `contracts/types.js`。 --- ## 🟡 建议修（影响体验/可维护性） ### 4. DianPage — history 是临时 state，刷新就没了 ```js const [history, setHistory] = useState([]); // 契印谱 ``` 落印后只存内存，**用户刷新页面就消失**。这页本质是"铸契"，丢了等于没铸。 **优化：** - 至少 localStorage 持久化 - 更好的：调用合约 `LicenseNFT.mint()`，从链上读 `getEvents(SealCast)` - 没接合约前，存 localStorage + 显示"待上链"标签 ### 6. JingCompPage — "上一轮/下一轮"是空操作 ```js ``` `setRound` 但**列表是写死的 RANKING**，`round` 没用。这功能等于不存在。 要么：接后端按 round 拉数据；要么：先删掉按钮，别让人点空气。 ### 7. App.jsx — NavLink 4 次几乎一样 ```jsx {({ isActive }) => (境)} // 典/源/竞 重复 3 遍 ``` 抽成数据驱动的 map： ```jsx const NAV = [{to:'/jing', label:'境'}, ...]; {NAV.map(n => {n.label})} ``` 省 20 行，未来加 nav 改一处。 ### 8. PageWrapper — fade-in 在每次路由切换都重 mount ```js const [fade, setFade] = useState(false); useEffect(() => { setFade(true); return () => setFade(false); }, []); ``` 依赖空数组 → **只在挂载时执行一次**。路由切换时旧组件 unmount 新组件 mount，新组件还是从 `fade=false` 起步。所以动画**只在首次加载有效**，切页面反而没动画（因为 transition-all 300ms 也跑了，但确实是 false→true）。 要么依赖 `[location.pathname]`，要么用 framer-motion / react-transition-group 替代。 ### 9. WalletBar — 重复 useEffect 算余额 ```js // useWallet.js const refreshBalance = ... // 已实现 // WalletBar.jsx useEffect(() => { if (!provider || !address) ... provider.getBalance(address).then(...) }, [provider, address]); // 又算一遍 ``` WalletBar 又写了一遍拉余额。直接 `useWalletContext().balance` 就行。 ### 10. 颜色不一致 — tailwind 配的色没人用 `tailwind.config.js` 配了 `cream/ink/muted/coral/sage/amber/emerald` 一套完整色板，**代码里几乎没人用**。全在用 `bg-[#faf9f7]` `text-[#2D2A26]` 这种硬编码 hex。 **优化：** - 一旦主题色要改（比如老板觉得朱砂太重），硬编码改 50+ 处 - 改用 `bg-cream text-ink` 语义化，IDE 有提示 - 配的 emerald `#6B9E87` 跟 nav 下划线一致，但代码用 `bg-[#6B9E87]` 直接硬写 --- ## 🟢 小优化（锦上添花） ### 11. useCase.js — `processingRef` 保护了 setLoading 但保护错了东西 ```js if (processingRef.current) return; processingRef.current = true; ``` 这个 ref 防的是**同一 hook 实例**并发调用。问题是 `useCase` 每次组件渲染都创建新函数，但 ref 是闭包内的——其实 OK。但是 `signer` 变化时 useCallback 重建函数，ref 状态会变。要么用 useRef 在 hook 顶部、要么写在更外层（自定义 hook 实例稳定）。 更根本：**这是 `disabled` 应该做的事**，按钮加 `disabled={loading}` 就够。 ### 12. ErrorBoundary 没有 reset 机制 ```js if (this.state.hasError) { return
...
; } ``` 刷新太重了。应该 `this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null })` 提供"恢复"按钮。 ### 13. Index.html / SEO / 加载态 没看 `index.html` 估计没设 ``/`<meta>`/OG 标签。如果部署到 Cloudflare Pages 公网演示，**SEO 和分享卡片是空白**。建议加： ```html <title>ECHO — 势位如川 ``` --- ## 🏗️ 架构层建议（动结构） ### 14. 缺一个全局数据层 现在 JingPage 拉了 `/api/potential` 但只在组件内 state——切到其他页再切回来又重新请求。 **建议：** 用 React Query / SWR，或者至少 `contexts/DataContext.jsx` 把后端数据提升到 Provider 层，缓存 + 共享。 ### 15. 错误处理没有统一 - JingPage 自己 try/catch + 8s 超时 - useCase / useWallet 各自 setError - UI 层都没消费 `error` state 显示 应该建 `components/ErrorToast.jsx` + 全局 ErrorContext 统一处理。 ### 16. 后端地址硬编码 `JingPage` 里 `const API_BASE = 'https://echo-api.meerfans.club'`，应该走 env：`import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE`。 （注：之前 GitHub PAT 失效时也提到这个迁移问题，根因之一就是配置散落。） --- ## 优先级排序 | 优先级 | 项目 | 工时 | 价值 | |:--:|:--|:--:|:--| | P0 | 1. 死数据三个页面 | 半天 | 验收通过 | | P0 | 3. 锁 schema | 1h | 后续不返工 | | P1 | 2. useWallet 切链 bug | 30min | 切链就崩 | | P1 | 16. API_BASE 走 env | 10min | 防止再迁移 | | P1 | 5. DianPage history 持久化 | 30min | demo 不丢数据 | | P2 | 6. JingComp 假按钮 | 5min | 不骗自己 | | P2 | 7-10. 重构清理 | 1h | 可维护 | | P3 | 4. 心电图换库 | 2h | 未来扩展 | **我的建议：** 1. 先把 P0+P1 做了，这堆代码才"真能用" 2. 然后约猫先森 / Seaman_bot 锁 schema，开 1.1 数据接口 3. 重构可以排到下个迭代 要我现在动手改哪几个？还是先开会拉齐接口？

代码全看完了。现在我做一份有观点的诊断报告。 --- # ECHO v2 前端诊断报告 **整体判断：** 架构干净、风格统一（暖白 + 朱砂的传统视觉语言拿捏到位），但在**数据真实性、健壮性、性能、状态管理**四方面有明显可优化点。属于"看起来能跑、接真实链上数据会出问题"的阶段。 --- ## 🔴 必须修（影响功能/数据真实性） ### 1. DianPage / YuanPage / JingCompPage — 全是死数据 这三个页面**完全没有接后端**。 - `DianPage` 写死 `FOUR_SEALS`、configs、history 全部本地 state - `YuanPage` 写死 `WORKS`、`SOURCE_TREE`、纪年 - `JingCompPage` 写死 `RANKING`（势位榜）、`DERIVATIVES`（脉络） **问题：** 验收会上 4 个页面（境/典/源/竞），但只有**境（JingPage）真在拉后端**。其他三个是 demo 数据，演示完等于没做。 **优化方向：** - 沿用 JingPage 的 `useEffect + AbortController` 模式 - 在 `hooks/` 加 `useLicenses()`、`useRanking()`、`useSourceTree()` 三个数据 hook - 缺少的后端接口要催 Seaman_bot 出 ### 2. useWallet.js — chainChanged 处理有 bug ```js const handleChainChanged = () => { if (provider) refreshBalance(provider, address).catch(() => {}); }; ``` `address` 来自闭包——监听器注册时把当时的 `address` 写死了。**用户切完链，地址可能已经变了**。要么 removeAllListeners 重建，要么改用 ref 拿最新值。 更严重：监听器里**没重新创建 provider/signer**——切链后旧的 `signer` 还在用旧链的 RPC，后续合约调用会直接报错。 ### 3. JingPage 数据契约混乱 后端给的字段名和前端假设对不齐： - `potential` vs `potentialValue`（两处 if-else 兜底） - `phase` vs `shiPosition`（同一个意思多处不同名） - 触发条件 `nextPhaseTrigger` 类型可能是 string / number / object - 四权 `fourRights[right]` 也是同样问题 页面上到处是 `JSON.stringify(node.potential ?? null)` 这种防御性代码，**说明 schema 没锁**。应该和 Seaman_bot 出一个明确的 TypeScript types 或者 zod schema，放在 `contracts/types.js`。 --- ## 🟡 建议修（影响体验/可维护性） ### 4. JingPage 心电图 — D3 比裸 Canvas 性价比高 手写 Canvas 画心电图没问题，但 60+ 行的 imperative 代码： - 缩放/dpi 处理散落在 effect 里 - 没有 hover tooltip（点击节点看不到具体值） - 没有动画过渡（新数据点直接跳出来） **优化：** 用 `recharts` 或 `visx` 一两百行搞定，还自带响应式和 tooltip。当前实现**未来要加交互就要重写**。 ### 5. DianPage — history 是临时 state，刷新就没了 ```js const [history, setHistory] = useState([]); // 契印谱 ``` 落印后只存内存，**用户刷新页面就消失**。这页本质是"铸契"，丢了等于没铸。 **优化：** - 至少 localStorage 持久化 - 更好的：调用合约 `LicenseNFT.mint()`，从链上读 `getEvents(SealCast)` - 没接合约前，存 localStorage + 显示"待上链"标签 ### 6. JingCompPage — "上一轮/下一轮"是空操作 ```js ``` `setRound` 但**列表是写死的 RANKING**，`round` 没用。这功能等于不存在。 要么：接后端按 round 拉数据；要么：先删掉按钮，别让人点空气。 ### 7. App.jsx — NavLink 4 次几乎一样 ```jsx {({ isActive }) => (境)} // 典/源/竞 重复 3 遍 ``` 抽成数据驱动的 map： ```jsx const NAV = [{to:'/jing', label:'境'}, ...]; {NAV.map(n => {n.label})} ``` 省 20 行，未来加 nav 改一处。 ### 8. PageWrapper — fade-in 在每次路由切换都重 mount ```js const [fade, setFade] = useState(false); useEffect(() => { setFade(true); return () => setFade(false); }, []); ``` 依赖空数组 → **只在挂载时执行一次**。路由切换时旧组件 unmount 新组件 mount，新组件还是从 `fade=false` 起步。所以动画**只在首次加载有效**，切页面反而没动画（因为 transition-all 300ms 也跑了，但确实是 false→true）。 要么依赖 `[location.pathname]`，要么用 framer-motion / react-transition-group 替代。 ### 9. WalletBar — 重复 useEffect 算余额 ```js // useWallet.js const refreshBalance = ... // 已实现 // WalletBar.jsx useEffect(() => { if (!provider || !address) ... provider.getBalance(address).then(...) }, [provider, address]); // 又算一遍 ``` WalletBar 又写了一遍拉余额。直接 `useWalletContext().balance` 就行。 ### 10. 颜色不一致 — tailwind 配的色没人用 `tailwind.config.js` 配了 `cream/ink/muted/coral/sage/amber/emerald` 一套完整色板，**代码里几乎没人用**。全在用 `bg-[#faf9f7]` `text-[#2D2A26]` 这种硬编码 hex。 **优化：** - 一旦主题色要改（比如老板觉得朱砂太重），硬编码改 50+ 处 - 改用 `bg-cream text-ink` 语义化，IDE 有提示 - 配的 emerald `#6B9E87` 跟 nav 下划线一致，但代码用 `bg-[#6B9E87]` 直接硬写 --- ## 🟢 小优化（锦上添花） ### 11. useCase.js — `processingRef` 保护了 setLoading 但保护错了东西 ```js if (processingRef.current) return; processingRef.current = true; ``` 这个 ref 防的是**同一 hook 实例**并发调用。问题是 `useCase` 每次组件渲染都创建新函数，但 ref 是闭包内的——其实 OK。但是 `signer` 变化时 useCallback 重建函数，ref 状态会变。要么用 useRef 在 hook 顶部、要么写在更外层（自定义 hook 实例稳定）。 更根本：**这是 `disabled` 应该做的事**，按钮加 `disabled={loading}` 就够。 ### 12. ErrorBoundary 没有 reset 机制 ```js if (this.state.hasError) { return
...
; } ``` 刷新太重了。应该 `this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null })` 提供"恢复"按钮。 ### 13. Index.html / SEO / 加载态 没看 `index.html` 估计没设 ``/`<meta>`/OG 标签。如果部署到 Cloudflare Pages 公网演示，**SEO 和分享卡片是空白**。建议加： ```html <title>ECHO — 势位如川 ``` --- ## 🏗️ 架构层建议（动结构） ### 14. 缺一个全局数据层 现在 JingPage 拉了 `/api/potential` 但只在组件内 state——切到其他页再切回来又重新请求。 **建议：** 用 React Query / SWR，或者至少 `contexts/DataContext.jsx` 把后端数据提升到 Provider 层，缓存 + 共享。 ### 15. 错误处理没有统一 - JingPage 自己 try/catch + 8s 超时 - useCase / useWallet 各自 setError - UI 层都没消费 `error` state 显示 应该建 `components/ErrorToast.jsx` + 全局 ErrorContext 统一处理。 ### 16. 后端地址硬编码 `JingPage` 里 `const API_BASE = 'https://echo-api.meerfans.club'`，应该走 env：`import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE`。 （注：之前 GitHub PAT 失效时也提到这个迁移问题，根因之一就是配置散落。） --- ## 优先级排序 | 优先级 | 项目 | 工时 | 价值 | |:--:|:--|:--:|:--| | P0 | 1. 死数据三个页面 | 半天 | 验收通过 | | P0 | 3. 锁 schema | 1h | 后续不返工 | | P1 | 2. useWallet 切链 bug | 30min | 切链就崩 | | P1 | 16. API_BASE 走 env | 10min | 防止再迁移 | | P1 | 5. DianPage history 持久化 | 30min | demo 不丢数据 | | P2 | 6. JingComp 假按钮 | 5min | 不骗自己 | | P2 | 7-10. 重构清理 | 1h | 可维护 | | P3 | 4. 心电图换库 | 2h | 未来扩展 | **我的建议：** 1. 先把 P0+P1 做了，这堆代码才"真能用" 2. 然后约猫先森 / Seaman_bot 锁 schema，开 1.1 数据接口 3. 重构可以排到下个迭代 要我现在动手改哪几个？还是先开会拉齐接口？

tools.name: agents_list
tools.description: List agent ids allowed for `sessions_spawn runtime="subagent"`.

tools.name: cron
tools.description:
Manage Gateway cron jobs and wake events: reminders, check-back-later, delayed follow-ups, recurring work. Do not emulate scheduling with exec sleep/process polling.

Main cron => system events for heartbeat. Isolated cron => background task in `openclaw tasks`.

ACTIONS:
- status: scheduler status
- list: jobs; includeDisabled true includes disabled; agentId filter auto-filled from session
- get: one job; needs jobId
- add: create job; needs job object
- update: patch job; needs jobId + patch
- remove: delete job; needs jobId
- run: trigger now; needs jobId
- runs: run history; needs jobId
- wake: send wake event; needs text, optional mode

JOB SCHEMA (for add action):
{
  "name": "string",
  "schedule": { ... },      // required
  "payload": { ... },       // required
  "delivery": { ... },      // optional announce for isolated/current/session, webhook for any target
  "sessionTarget": "main" | "isolated" | "current" | "session:<id>",
  "enabled": true | false   // default true
}

SESSION TARGET OPTIONS:
- "main": main session; requires payload.kind="systemEvent"
- "isolated": ephemeral isolated session; requires payload.kind="agentTurn"
- "current": bind current session at creation
- "session:<id>": persistent named session

DEFAULTS:
- payload.kind="systemEvent" → defaults to "main"
- payload.kind="agentTurn" → defaults to "isolated"
Current binding needs sessionTarget="current".

SCHEDULE TYPES (schedule.kind):
- "at": one-shot absolute time
  { "kind": "at", "at": "<ISO-8601 timestamp>" }
- "every": recurring interval
  { "kind": "every", "everyMs": <ms>, "anchorMs": <optional-ms> }
- "cron": expr in supplied timezone, or Gateway host local timezone when tz omitted
  { "kind": "cron", "expr": "<cron-expression>", "tz": "<optional-IANA-timezone>" }
  Write expr in local wall-clock time; do not convert the requested local time to UTC first.
  tz omitted => Gateway host local timezone, not UTC.
  Example 6pm Shanghai daily: { "kind": "cron", "expr": "0 18 * * *", "tz": "Asia/Shanghai" }

For "at", ISO timestamps without timezone are UTC.

PAYLOAD TYPES (payload.kind):
- "systemEvent": inject text as system event
  { "kind": "systemEvent", "text": "<message>" }
- "agentTurn": run agent with prompt; isolated/current/session only
  { "kind": "agentTurn", "message": "<prompt>", "model": "<optional>", "thinking": "<optional>", "timeoutSeconds": <optional, 0=no timeout> }

DELIVERY (top-level):
  { "mode": "none|announce|webhook", "channel": "<optional>", "to": "<optional>", "threadId": "<optional>", "bestEffort": <optional-bool> }
  - isolated agentTurn default when omitted: "announce"
  - announce: send to chat channel; isolated/current/session only; optional channel/to
  - threadId: chat thread/topic id
  - webhook: POST finished-run event to delivery.to URL
  - Specific chat/recipient: set announce delivery.channel/to; do not call messaging tools inside run.

CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS:
- sessionTarget="main" REQUIRES payload.kind="systemEvent"
- sessionTarget="isolated" | "current" | "session:xxx" REQUIRES payload.kind="agentTurn"
- Webhook: delivery.mode="webhook" and delivery.to URL.
Default: prefer isolated agentTurn jobs unless the user explicitly wants current-session binding.

RESTRICTED CRON RUNS:
- Some isolated cron runs get narrow self-cleanup grant: status/list self-only, get/runs current job only, mutation only remove current job.

WAKE MODES (for wake action):
- "next-heartbeat" default: wake next heartbeat
- "now": wake immediately

Use jobId canonical; id accepted compat. contextMessages (0-10) adds previous messages as job context.

tools.name: exec
tools.description: Execute shell commands with background continuation for work that starts now. Use yieldMs/background to continue later via process tool. For long-running work started now, rely on automatic completion wake when it is enabled and the command emits output or fails; otherwise use process to confirm completion. Use process whenever you need logs, status, input, or intervention. Do not use exec sleep or delay loops for reminders or deferred follow-ups; use cron instead. Use pty=true for TTY-required commands (terminal UIs, coding agents).

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, kills process on expiry)

pty.description: Run in a pseudo-terminal (PTY) when available (TTY-required CLIs, coding agents)

elevated.description: Run on the host with elevated permissions (if allowed)

security.description: Ignored for normal calls; exec security is set by tools.exec.security and host approvals.

tools.name: gateway
tools.description: Gateway restart/config/update. Before config edits, use config.schema.lookup with targeted dot path. Prefer config.patch for partial merge; config.apply only full replace. Writes hot-reload or restart as needed. Always pass human `note` for post-restart delivery. If still owe the user a reply, pass one-shot `continuationMessage`; do not write restart sentinel files directly.

tools.name: image
tools.description: Analyze images with available vision model. Use image for one path/URL, images for max 20. Prompt says what to inspect.

tools.name: image_generate
tools.description: Create/edit images. Session chats: background task; do not call image_generate again for same request; wait completion, then send attachments via message tool. Transparent: outputFormat="png" or "webp" + background="transparent"; OpenAI also supports openai.background and routes default model to gpt-image-1.5. Use action="list" for providers/models/readiness/auth, "status" for active task.

model.description: Provider/model override, e.g. openai/gpt-image-2; transparent OpenAI: openai/gpt-image-1.5.

filename.description: Output filename hint; basename preserved in managed media dir.

background.description: Background: transparent, opaque, auto. Transparent needs png/webp output.

tools.name: memory_get
tools.description: Safe exact excerpt read from MEMORY.md or memory/*.md. Defaults to a bounded excerpt when lines are omitted, includes truncation/continuation info when more content exists, and `corpus=wiki` reads from registered compiled-wiki supplements.

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Mandatory recall step: semantically search MEMORY.md + memory/*.md (and optional session transcripts) before answering questions about prior work, decisions, dates, people, preferences, or todos. Optional `corpus=wiki` or `corpus=all` also searches registered compiled-wiki supplements. `corpus=memory` restricts hits to indexed memory files (excludes session transcript chunks from ranking). `corpus=sessions` restricts hits to indexed session transcripts (same visibility rules as session history tools). If response has disabled=true, memory retrieval is unavailable and should be surfaced to the user.

tools.name: message
tools.description: Send/delete/manage channel messages. Supports actions: channel-info, channel-list, edit, list-pins, member-info, pin, react, reactions, read, send, thread-reply, unpin. Use action="read" with threadId to fetch prior messages in a thread when you need conversation context you do not have yet.

target.description: Recipient/channel: E.164 for WhatsApp/Signal, Telegram chat id/@username, Discord/Slack/Mattermost <channelId|user:ID|channel:ID>, or iMessage handle/chat_id

buffer.description: Base64 attachment payload; data URL ok.

forceDocument.description: Send image/GIF/video as document; avoids compression.

presentation.description: Rich message payload: text/buttons/selects/context. Unsupported blocks degrade to text.

messageId.description: Target message id for read/react/edit/delete/pin/unpin. Reaction-like defaults current inbound id when available.

message_id.description: snake_case alias of messageId; same defaults.

trackToolCalls.description: For current-message reaction, make reacted message the tool-progress reaction target.

tools.name: music_generate
tools.description: Create audio/music for song, jingle, beat, loop, soundtrack, anthem, instrumental requests. If user asks make/generate/create song/music, call music_generate; do not just write lyrics unless lyrics/text only. Prompt gets style/genre/mood/tempo/instruments/purpose. lyrics only exact sung words. Session chats: background task; do not call again for same request; wait completion, send attachments via message tool. "status" checks active task.

prompt.description: Music prompt: style, genre, mood, purpose.

lyrics.description: Exact sung lyrics only when the user supplies lyrics or asks for vocal words. For song/style requests, use prompt instead.

filename.description: Output filename hint; basename preserved in managed media dir.

tools.name: nodes
tools.description: Discover/control paired nodes: status, describe, pairing, notify, camera/photos/screen/location/notifications/invoke. Use file_fetch for files.

tools.name: pdf
tools.description: Analyze PDFs with model. Anthropic/Google native PDF when supported; else text/image extraction. Use pdf for one, pdfs for max 10; prompt says what to inspect.

tools.name: process
tools.description: Manage running exec sessions for commands already started: list, poll, log, write, send-keys, submit, paste, kill. Use poll/log when you need status, logs, quiet-success confirmation, or completion confirmation when automatic completion wake is unavailable. Use poll/log also for input-wait hints. Use write/send-keys/submit/paste/kill for input or intervention. Do not use process polling to emulate timers or reminders; use cron for scheduled follow-ups.

sessionId.description: Session id for actions other than list

keys.description: Key tokens to send for send-keys

hex.description: Hex bytes to send for send-keys

timeout.description: For poll: wait up to this many milliseconds before returning; max 30000 ms, higher values are clamped to 30000

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

tools.name: session_status
tools.description: Show /status-like card for current/visible session: model, usage, time, cost, tasks. Use `sessionKey="current"` for current session; UI labels like `openclaw-tui` are not keys. `model` sets session override; `model=default` resets. Use for active model/session config questions.

tools.name: sessions_history
tools.description: Fetch sanitized history for visible session. Use before replying, debugging, resuming; supports limits/tool messages.

tools.name: sessions_list
tools.description: List visible sessions; filter by kind, label, agentId, search, activity. Use before sessions_history or sessions_send target selection.

tools.name: sessions_send
tools.description: Send message to visible session by sessionKey/label, or configured agent by agentId. Thread-scoped chats rejected; target parent channel session. Creates missing configured-agent main session; waits for reply when available.

tools.name: sessions_spawn
tools.description: Spawn clean child session; default `runtime="subagent"`. `mode="run"` one-shot background work. Subagents inherit parent workspace. Native subagents get task in first visible `[Subagent Task]` message. Native only: `context="fork"` only when child needs current transcript; else omit or `isolated`. Use for fresh child-session work.

taskName.description: Stable alias for later targeting; lowercase letters/digits/underscores, starts letter.

context.description: Native context. Omit/"isolated" for clean child; "fork" only when child needs requester transcript.

tools.name: sessions_yield
tools.description: End current turn. Use after spawning subagents; results arrive as next message.

tools.name: subagents
tools.description: List/kill/steer spawned subagents for requester session. If sessions_yield exists, use it for completion; do not poll wait loops.

tools.name: tavily_extract
tools.description: Extract clean content from one or more URLs using Tavily. Handles JS-rendered pages. Supports query-focused chunking.

urls.description: One or more URLs to extract content from (max 20).

query.description: Rerank extracted chunks by relevance to this query.

include_images.description: Include image URLs in extraction results.

tools.name: tavily_search
tools.description: Search the web using Tavily Search API. Supports search depth, topic filtering, domain filters, time ranges, and AI answer summaries.

include_answer.description: Include an AI-generated answer summary (default: false).

include_domains.description: Only include results from these domains.

tools.name: tts
tools.description: Use only for explicit audio intent (voice/speech/TTS) or active TTS config. Never use for ordinary text replies. Audio auto-delivered from tool result; after success follow reply instructions, no duplicate text/audio.

tools.name: update_plan
tools.description: Update current run plan. Use for non-trivial multi-step work; keep plan current while executing. Short steps; max one `in_progress`; skip for simple one-step work.

tools.name: video_generate
tools.description: Create videos. Session chats: background task; do not call video_generate again for same request; wait completion, then send attachments via message tool. "status" checks active task. Duration may round to provider-supported value.

imageRoles.description: `image` + `images` roles by index after de-dupe. Values: first_frame, last_frame, reference_image; empty string leaves unset.

videoRoles.description: `video` + `videos` roles by index after de-dupe. Value: reference_video; empty string leaves unset.

filename.description: Output filename hint; basename preserved in managed media dir.

aspectRatio.description: Aspect ratio: 1:1, 16:9, 9:16, "adaptive", or provider value; unsupported normalized/ignored.

resolution.description: Resolution: 480P, 720P, 768P, 1080P, 4K, or provider value; unsupported normalized/ignored.

durationSeconds.description: Target seconds; may round to nearest supported duration.

providerOptions.description: Provider JSON options, e.g. {"seed":42}. Keys/types must match provider capabilities; mismatch skips candidate. Use action=list for accepted keys.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Fetch URL and extract readable markdown/text. Lightweight page access; no browser automation.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search web for current info; returns normalized provider results.

tools.name: write
tools.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

DianPage — history 是临时 state，刷新就没了 ```js const [history, setHistory] = useState([]); // 契印谱 ``` 落印后只存内存，**用户刷新页面就消失**。这页本质是"铸契"，丢了等于没铸。 **优化：** - 至少 localStorage 持久化 - 更好的：调用合约 `LicenseNFT.mint()`，从链上读 `getEvents(SealCast)` - 没接合约前，存 localStorage + 显示"待上链"标签 ### 6. PageWrapper — fade-in 在每次路由切换都重 mount ```js const [fade, setFade] = useState(false); useEffect(() => { setFade(true); return () => setFade(false); }, []); ``` 依赖空数组 → **只在挂载时执行一次**。路由切换时旧组件 unmount 新组件 mount，新组件还是从 `fade=false` 起步。所以动画**只在首次加载有效**，切页面反而没动画（因为 transition-all 300ms 也跑了，但确实是 false→true）。 要么依赖 `[location.pathname]`，要么用 framer-motion / react-transition-group 替代。 ### 9. 代码全看完了。现在我做一份有观点的诊断报告。 --- # ECHO v2 前端诊断报告 **整体判断：** 架构干净、风格统一（暖白 + 朱砂的传统视觉语言拿捏到位），但在**数据真实性、健壮性、性能、状态管理**四方面有明显可优化点。属于"看起来能跑、接真实链上数据会出问题"的阶段。 --- ## 🔴 必须修（影响功能/数据真实性） ### 1. DianPage / YuanPage / JingCompPage — 全是死数据 这三个页面**完全没有接后端**。 - `DianPage` 写死 `FOUR_SEALS`、configs、history 全部本地 state - `YuanPage` 写死 `WORKS`、`SOURCE_TREE`、纪年 - `JingCompPage` 写死 `RANKING`（势位榜）、`DERIVATIVES`（脉络） **问题：** 验收会上 4 个页面（境/典/源/竞），但只有**境（JingPage）真在拉后端**。其他三个是 demo 数据，演示完等于没做。 **优化方向：** - 沿用 JingPage 的 `useEffect + AbortController` 模式 - 在 `hooks/` 加 `useLicenses()`、`useRanking()`、`useSourceTree()` 三个数据 hook - 缺少的后端接口要催 Seaman_bot 出 ### 2. useWallet.js — chainChanged 处理有 bug ```js const handleChainChanged = () => { if (provider) refreshBalance(provider, address).catch(() => {}); }; ``` `address` 来自闭包——监听器注册时把当时的 `address` 写死了。**用户切完链，地址可能已经变了**。要么 removeAllListeners 重建，要么改用 ref 拿最新值。 更严重：监听器里**没重新创建 provider/signer**——切链后旧的 `signer` 还在用旧链的 RPC，后续合约调用会直接报错。 ### 3. JingPage 数据契约混乱 后端给的字段名和前端假设对不齐： - `potential` vs `potentialValue`（两处 if-else 兜底） - `phase` vs `shiPosition`（同一个意思多处不同名） - 触发条件 `nextPhaseTrigger` 类型可能是 string / number / object - 四权 `fourRights[right]` 也是同样问题 页面上到处是 `JSON.stringify(node.potential ?? null)` 这种防御性代码，**说明 schema 没锁**。应该和 Seaman_bot 出一个明确的 TypeScript types 或者 zod schema，放在 `contracts/types.js`。 --- ## 🟡 建议修（影响体验/可维护性） ### 4. JingPage 心电图 — D3 比裸 Canvas 性价比高 手写 Canvas 画心电图没问题，但 60+ 行的 imperative 代码： - 缩放/dpi 处理散落在 effect 里 - 没有 hover tooltip（点击节点看不到具体值） - 没有动画过渡（新数据点直接跳出来） **优化：** 用 `recharts` 或 `visx` 一两百行搞定，还自带响应式和 tooltip。当前实现**未来要加交互就要重写**。 ### 5. DianPage — history 是临时 state，刷新就没了 ```js const [history, setHistory] = useState([]); // 契印谱 ``` 落印后只存内存，**用户刷新页面就消失**。这页本质是"铸契"，丢了等于没铸。 **优化：** - 至少 localStorage 持久化 - 更好的：调用合约 `LicenseNFT.mint()`，从链上读 `getEvents(SealCast)` - 没接合约前，存 localStorage + 显示"待上链"标签 ### 6. JingCompPage — "上一轮/下一轮"是空操作 ```js ``` `setRound` 但**列表是写死的 RANKING**，`round` 没用。这功能等于不存在。 要么：接后端按 round 拉数据；要么：先删掉按钮，别让人点空气。 ### 7. App.jsx — NavLink 4 次几乎一样 ```jsx {({ isActive }) => (境)} // 典/源/竞 重复 3 遍 ``` 抽成数据驱动的 map： ```jsx const NAV = [{to:'/jing', label:'境'}, ...]; {NAV.map(n => {n.label})} ``` 省 20 行，未来加 nav 改一处。 ### 8. PageWrapper — fade-in 在每次路由切换都重 mount ```js const [fade, setFade] = useState(false); useEffect(() => { setFade(true); return () => setFade(false); }, []); ``` 依赖空数组 → **只在挂载时执行一次**。路由切换时旧组件 unmount 新组件 mount，新组件还是从 `fade=false` 起步。所以动画**只在首次加载有效**，切页面反而没动画（因为 transition-all 300ms 也跑了，但确实是 false→true）。 要么依赖 `[location.pathname]`，要么用 framer-motion / react-transition-group 替代。 ### 9. WalletBar — 重复 useEffect 算余额 ```js // useWallet.js const refreshBalance = ... // 已实现 // WalletBar.jsx useEffect(() => { if (!provider || !address) ... provider.getBalance(address).then(...) }, [provider, address]); // 又算一遍 ``` WalletBar 又写了一遍拉余额。直接 `useWalletContext().balance` 就行。 ### 10. 颜色不一致 — tailwind 配的色没人用 `tailwind.config.js` 配了 `cream/ink/muted/coral/sage/amber/emerald` 一套完整色板，**代码里几乎没人用**。全在用 `bg-[#faf9f7]` `text-[#2D2A26]` 这种硬编码 hex。 **优化：** - 一旦主题色要改（比如老板觉得朱砂太重），硬编码改 50+ 处 - 改用 `bg-cream text-ink` 语义化，IDE 有提示 - 配的 emerald `#6B9E87` 跟 nav 下划线一致，但代码用 `bg-[#6B9E87]` 直接硬写 --- ## 🟢 小优化（锦上添花） ### 11. useCase.js — `processingRef` 保护了 setLoading 但保护错了东西 ```js if (processingRef.current) return; processingRef.current = true; ``` 这个 ref 防的是**同一 hook 实例**并发调用。问题是 `useCase` 每次组件渲染都创建新函数，但 ref 是闭包内的——其实 OK。但是 `signer` 变化时 useCallback 重建函数，ref 状态会变。要么用 useRef 在 hook 顶部、要么写在更外层（自定义 hook 实例稳定）。 更根本：**这是 `disabled` 应该做的事**，按钮加 `disabled={loading}` 就够。 ### 12. ErrorBoundary 没有 reset 机制 ```js if (this.state.hasError) { return
...
; } ``` 刷新太重了。应该 `this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null })` 提供"恢复"按钮。 ### 13. Index.html / SEO / 加载态 没看 `index.html` 估计没设 ``/`<meta>`/OG 标签。如果部署到 Cloudflare Pages 公网演示，**SEO 和分享卡片是空白**。建议加： ```html <title>ECHO — 势位如川 ``` --- ## 🏗️ 架构层建议（动结构） ### 14. 缺一个全局数据层 现在 JingPage 拉了 `/api/potential` 但只在组件内 state——切到其他页再切回来又重新请求。 **建议：** 用 React Query / SWR，或者至少 `contexts/DataContext.jsx` 把后端数据提升到 Provider 层，缓存 + 共享。 ### 15. 错误处理没有统一 - JingPage 自己 try/catch + 8s 超时 - useCase / useWallet 各自 setError - UI 层都没消费 `error` state 显示 应该建 `components/ErrorToast.jsx` + 全局 ErrorContext 统一处理。 ### 16. 后端地址硬编码 `JingPage` 里 `const API_BASE = 'https://echo-api.meerfans.club'`，应该走 env：`import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE`。 （注：之前 GitHub PAT 失效时也提到这个迁移问题，根因之一就是配置散落。） --- ## 优先级排序 | 优先级 | 项目 | 工时 | 价值 | |:--:|:--|:--:|:--| | P0 | 1. 死数据三个页面 | 半天 | 验收通过 | | P0 | 3. 锁 schema | 1h | 后续不返工 | | P1 | 2. useWallet 切链 bug | 30min | 切链就崩 | | P1 | 16. API_BASE 走 env | 10min | 防止再迁移 | | P1 | 5. DianPage history 持久化 | 30min | demo 不丢数据 | | P2 | 6. JingComp 假按钮 | 5min | 不骗自己 | | P2 | 7-10. 重构清理 | 1h | 可维护 | | P3 | 4. 心电图换库 | 2h | 未来扩展 | **我的建议：** 1. 先把 P0+P1 做了，这堆代码才"真能用" 2. 然后约猫先森 / Seaman_bot 锁 schema，开 1.1 数据接口 3. 重构可以排到下个迭代 要我现在动手改哪几个？还是先开会拉齐接口？

1. **真有数据**：5 个节点、4 条边、1 个 round、0 战斗
2. **`/api/milestones` 是空** — YuanPage 原本就是 demo 数据，没真实数据源

# 完工报告

## 改动清单

**新增文件（4）**
- `src/contracts/types.js` — 单一真理源：`normalizeNode` / `normalizeEdges` / `normalizeRound` / `PHASE_NAMES` / `FOUR_SEALS`
- `src/utils/api.js` — 统一 API 客户端（`apiGet` + 6 个端点封装 + `import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE`）
- `src/utils/runtimeConfig.js` — 读 env（ECHO_VERSION / CHAIN_ID / RPC_URLS）
- `.env.example` / `.env.local` / `.env.production`

**重写文件（6）**
- `src/pages/JingPage.jsx` — 用归一化数据，删除所有 `JSON.stringify(...)` 防御代码
- `src/pages/DianPage.jsx` — 接 `/api/nodes`+`/api/edges`，契印状态从 `fourRights` 反推，history 持久化到 localStorage（标"已上链/本地"）
- `src/pages/YuanPage.jsx` — 著录=节点列表，源流谱=边列表，纪年=节点时间线。**全部从真数据来**
- `src/pages/JingCompPage.jsx` — 接 `/api/game/rounds` + `/api/game/round/:id`，"上下轮"按钮接真数据，`disabled` 控制边界
- `src/hooks/useWallet.js` — 切链重建 provider/signer；accountsChanged 用 ref 拿最新 address
- `src/components/WalletBar.jsx` — 删了重复 useEffect，消费 `context.balance`

## 验证

```
✅ vite build: 7.22s, 473.98 kB (gzip 163 kB)
✅ esbuild 语法检查：12/12 文件通过
✅ /api/health: 200 OK (5 nodes, 4 edges, 1 round, 0 bets)
```

## 解决的关键问题

| 问题 | 修复 |
|:--|:--|
| 4 个页面有 3 个是死数据 | Dian/Yuan/JingComp 全部接真 API |
| 字段名漂移（`potential` vs `potentialValue`，`phase` vs `shiPosition`） | `normalizeNode` 归一化，前端只用 NormalizedNode |
| 切链后旧 provider 还在用 | `chainChanged` 重建 provider/signer |
| 监听器闭包拿旧 address | 用 `useRef` 跟踪最新值 |
| 契印谱刷新就丢 | localStorage 持久化（最多 50 条） |
| `API_BASE` 硬编码 | 走 `VITE_API_BASE`，配 `.env.example` |
| WalletBar 重复拉余额 | 直接消费 `useWalletContext().balance` |

## 还能继续做的（不在 P0/P1，留给下一轮）

- **React Query / SWR** — 现在每个 page 独立 useEffect 拉数据，切页面再回来又重新请求。需要全局缓存层
- **错误处理统一** — 各页自己 try/catch 显示错误，应该有 `ErrorToast` + 全局 ErrorContext
- **落印真上链** — DianPage 的 `handleSave` 现在只写 localStorage，要等 `LicenseNFT.mint` 接口稳定
- **JingPage 心电图换库** — 裸 Canvas 60 行够用，但加 tooltip/动画就吃力了
- **DianPage 重光印的语义** — `reproduce` 字段不在后端 `fourRights` 四项里，目前映射到 `benefit`，要跟猫先森确认

## 部署注意

- `dist/` 已重新构建
- 部署到 Cloudflare Pages 需在 dashboard 配 `VITE_API_BASE=https://echo-api.meerfans.club`（或直接用 `.env.production`）

代码全看完了。现在我做一份有观点的诊断报告。 --- # ECHO v2 前端诊断报告 **整体判断：** 架构干净、风格统一（暖白 + 朱砂的传统视觉语言拿捏到位），但在**数据真实性、健壮性、性能、状态管理**四方面有明显可优化点。属于"看起来能跑、接真实链上数据会出问题"的阶段。 --- ## 🔴 必须修（影响功能/数据真实性） ### 1. DianPage / YuanPage / JingCompPage — 全是死数据 这三个页面**完全没有接后端**。 - `DianPage` 写死 `FOUR_SEALS`、configs、history 全部本地 state - `YuanPage` 写死 `WORKS`、`SOURCE_TREE`、纪年 - `JingCompPage` 写死 `RANKING`（势位榜）、`DERIVATIVES`（脉络） **问题：** 验收会上 4 个页面（境/典/源/竞），但只有**境（JingPage）真在拉后端**。其他三个是 demo 数据，演示完等于没做。 **优化方向：** - 沿用 JingPage 的 `useEffect + AbortController` 模式 - 在 `hooks/` 加 `useLicenses()`、`useRanking()`、`useSourceTree()` 三个数据 hook - 缺少的后端接口要催 Seaman_bot 出 ### 2. useWallet.js — chainChanged 处理有 bug ```js const handleChainChanged = () => { if (provider) refreshBalance(provider, address).catch(() => {}); }; ``` `address` 来自闭包——监听器注册时把当时的 `address` 写死了。**用户切完链，地址可能已经变了**。要么 removeAllListeners 重建，要么改用 ref 拿最新值。 更严重：监听器里**没重新创建 provider/signer**——切链后旧的 `signer` 还在用旧链的 RPC，后续合约调用会直接报错。 ### 3. JingPage 数据契约混乱 后端给的字段名和前端假设对不齐： - `potential` vs `potentialValue`（两处 if-else 兜底） - `phase` vs `shiPosition`（同一个意思多处不同名） - 触发条件 `nextPhaseTrigger` 类型可能是 string / number / object - 四权 `fourRights[right]` 也是同样问题 页面上到处是 `JSON.stringify(node.potential ?? null)` 这种防御性代码，**说明 schema 没锁**。应该和 Seaman_bot 出一个明确的 TypeScript types 或者 zod schema，放在 `contracts/types.js`。 --- ## 🟡 建议修（影响体验/可维护性） ### 4. JingPage 心电图 — D3 比裸 Canvas 性价比高 手写 Canvas 画心电图没问题，但 60+ 行的 imperative 代码： - 缩放/dpi 处理散落在 effect 里 - 没有 hover tooltip（点击节点看不到具体值） - 没有动画过渡（新数据点直接跳出来） **优化：** 用 `recharts` 或 `visx` 一两百行搞定，还自带响应式和 tooltip。当前实现**未来要加交互就要重写**。 ### 5. DianPage — history 是临时 state，刷新就没了 ```js const [history, setHistory] = useState([]); // 契印谱 ``` 落印后只存内存，**用户刷新页面就消失**。这页本质是"铸契"，丢了等于没铸。 **优化：** - 至少 localStorage 持久化 - 更好的：调用合约 `LicenseNFT.mint()`，从链上读 `getEvents(SealCast)` - 没接合约前，存 localStorage + 显示"待上链"标签 ### 6. JingCompPage — "上一轮/下一轮"是空操作 ```js ``` `setRound` 但**列表是写死的 RANKING**，`round` 没用。这功能等于不存在。 要么：接后端按 round 拉数据；要么：先删掉按钮，别让人点空气。 ### 7. App.jsx — NavLink 4 次几乎一样 ```jsx {({ isActive }) => (境)} // 典/源/竞 重复 3 遍 ``` 抽成数据驱动的 map： ```jsx const NAV = [{to:'/jing', label:'境'}, ...]; {NAV.map(n => {n.label})} ``` 省 20 行，未来加 nav 改一处。 ### 8. PageWrapper — fade-in 在每次路由切换都重 mount ```js const [fade, setFade] = useState(false); useEffect(() => { setFade(true); return () => setFade(false); }, []); ``` 依赖空数组 → **只在挂载时执行一次**。路由切换时旧组件 unmount 新组件 mount，新组件还是从 `fade=false` 起步。所以动画**只在首次加载有效**，切页面反而没动画（因为 transition-all 300ms 也跑了，但确实是 false→true）。 要么依赖 `[location.pathname]`，要么用 framer-motion / react-transition-group 替代。 ### 9. WalletBar — 重复 useEffect 算余额 ```js // useWallet.js const refreshBalance = ... // 已实现 // WalletBar.jsx useEffect(() => { if (!provider || !address) ... provider.getBalance(address).then(...) }, [provider, address]); // 又算一遍 ``` WalletBar 又写了一遍拉余额。直接 `useWalletContext().balance` 就行。 ### 10. 颜色不一致 — tailwind 配的色没人用 `tailwind.config.js` 配了 `cream/ink/muted/coral/sage/amber/emerald` 一套完整色板，**代码里几乎没人用**。全在用 `bg-[#faf9f7]` `text-[#2D2A26]` 这种硬编码 hex。 **优化：** - 一旦主题色要改（比如老板觉得朱砂太重），硬编码改 50+ 处 - 改用 `bg-cream text-ink` 语义化，IDE 有提示 - 配的 emerald `#6B9E87` 跟 nav 下划线一致，但代码用 `bg-[#6B9E87]` 直接硬写 --- ## 🟢 小优化（锦上添花） ### 11. useCase.js — `processingRef` 保护了 setLoading 但保护错了东西 ```js if (processingRef.current) return; processingRef.current = true; ``` 这个 ref 防的是**同一 hook 实例**并发调用。问题是 `useCase` 每次组件渲染都创建新函数，但 ref 是闭包内的——其实 OK。但是 `signer` 变化时 useCallback 重建函数，ref 状态会变。要么用 useRef 在 hook 顶部、要么写在更外层（自定义 hook 实例稳定）。 更根本：**这是 `disabled` 应该做的事**，按钮加 `disabled={loading}` 就够。 ### 12. ErrorBoundary 没有 reset 机制 ```js if (this.state.hasError) { return
...
; } ``` 刷新太重了。应该 `this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null })` 提供"恢复"按钮。 ### 13. Index.html / SEO / 加载态 没看 `index.html` 估计没设 ``/`<meta>`/OG 标签。如果部署到 Cloudflare Pages 公网演示，**SEO 和分享卡片是空白**。建议加： ```html <title>ECHO — 势位如川 ``` --- ## 🏗️ 架构层建议（动结构） ### 14. 缺一个全局数据层 现在 JingPage 拉了 `/api/potential` 但只在组件内 state——切到其他页再切回来又重新请求。 **建议：** 用 React Query / SWR，或者至少 `contexts/DataContext.jsx` 把后端数据提升到 Provider 层，缓存 + 共享。 ### 15. 错误处理没有统一 - JingPage 自己 try/catch + 8s 超时 - useCase / useWallet 各自 setError - UI 层都没消费 `error` state 显示 应该建 `components/ErrorToast.jsx` + 全局 ErrorContext 统一处理。 ### 16. 后端地址硬编码 `JingPage` 里 `const API_BASE = 'https://echo-api.meerfans.club'`，应该走 env：`import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE`。 （注：之前 GitHub PAT 失效时也提到这个迁移问题，根因之一就是配置散落。） --- ## 优先级排序 | 优先级 | 项目 | 工时 | 价值 | |:--:|:--|:--:|:--| | P0 | 1. 死数据三个页面 | 半天 | 验收通过 | | P0 | 3. 锁 schema | 1h | 后续不返工 | | P1 | 2. useWallet 切链 bug | 30min | 切链就崩 | | P1 | 16. API_BASE 走 env | 10min | 防止再迁移 | | P1 | 5. DianPage history 持久化 | 30min | demo 不丢数据 | | P2 | 6. JingComp 假按钮 | 5min | 不骗自己 | | P2 | 7-10. 重构清理 | 1h | 可维护 | | P3 | 4. 心电图换库 | 2h | 未来扩展 | **我的建议：** 1. 先把 P0+P1 做了，这堆代码才"真能用" 2. 然后约猫先森 / Seaman_bot 锁 schema，开 1.1 数据接口 3. 重构可以排到下个迭代 要我现在动手改哪几个？还是先开会拉齐接口？

tools.name: agents_list
tools.description: List agent ids allowed for `sessions_spawn runtime="subagent"`.

tools.name: cron
tools.description:
Manage Gateway cron jobs and wake events: reminders, check-back-later, delayed follow-ups, recurring work. Do not emulate scheduling with exec sleep/process polling.

Main cron => system events for heartbeat. Isolated cron => background task in `openclaw tasks`.

ACTIONS:
- status: scheduler status
- list: jobs; includeDisabled true includes disabled; agentId filter auto-filled from session
- get: one job; needs jobId
- add: create job; needs job object
- update: patch job; needs jobId + patch
- remove: delete job; needs jobId
- run: trigger now; needs jobId
- runs: run history; needs jobId
- wake: send wake event; needs text, optional mode

JOB SCHEMA (for add action):
{
  "name": "string",
  "schedule": { ... },      // required
  "payload": { ... },       // required
  "delivery": { ... },      // optional announce for isolated/current/session, webhook for any target
  "sessionTarget": "main" | "isolated" | "current" | "session:<id>",
  "enabled": true | false   // default true
}

SESSION TARGET OPTIONS:
- "main": main session; requires payload.kind="systemEvent"
- "isolated": ephemeral isolated session; requires payload.kind="agentTurn"
- "current": bind current session at creation
- "session:<id>": persistent named session

DEFAULTS:
- payload.kind="systemEvent" → defaults to "main"
- payload.kind="agentTurn" → defaults to "isolated"
Current binding needs sessionTarget="current".

SCHEDULE TYPES (schedule.kind):
- "at": one-shot absolute time
  { "kind": "at", "at": "<ISO-8601 timestamp>" }
- "every": recurring interval
  { "kind": "every", "everyMs": <ms>, "anchorMs": <optional-ms> }
- "cron": expr in supplied timezone, or Gateway host local timezone when tz omitted
  { "kind": "cron", "expr": "<cron-expression>", "tz": "<optional-IANA-timezone>" }
  Write expr in local wall-clock time; do not convert the requested local time to UTC first.
  tz omitted => Gateway host local timezone, not UTC.
  Example 6pm Shanghai daily: { "kind": "cron", "expr": "0 18 * * *", "tz": "Asia/Shanghai" }

For "at", ISO timestamps without timezone are UTC.

PAYLOAD TYPES (payload.kind):
- "systemEvent": inject text as system event
  { "kind": "systemEvent", "text": "<message>" }
- "agentTurn": run agent with prompt; isolated/current/session only
  { "kind": "agentTurn", "message": "<prompt>", "model": "<optional>", "thinking": "<optional>", "timeoutSeconds": <optional, 0=no timeout> }

DELIVERY (top-level):
  { "mode": "none|announce|webhook", "channel": "<optional>", "to": "<optional>", "threadId": "<optional>", "bestEffort": <optional-bool> }
  - isolated agentTurn default when omitted: "announce"
  - announce: send to chat channel; isolated/current/session only; optional channel/to
  - threadId: chat thread/topic id
  - webhook: POST finished-run event to delivery.to URL
  - Specific chat/recipient: set announce delivery.channel/to; do not call messaging tools inside run.

CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS:
- sessionTarget="main" REQUIRES payload.kind="systemEvent"
- sessionTarget="isolated" | "current" | "session:xxx" REQUIRES payload.kind="agentTurn"
- Webhook: delivery.mode="webhook" and delivery.to URL.
Default: prefer isolated agentTurn jobs unless the user explicitly wants current-session binding.

RESTRICTED CRON RUNS:
- Some isolated cron runs get narrow self-cleanup grant: status/list self-only, get/runs current job only, mutation only remove current job.

WAKE MODES (for wake action):
- "next-heartbeat" default: wake next heartbeat
- "now": wake immediately

Use jobId canonical; id accepted compat. contextMessages (0-10) adds previous messages as job context.

background.description: Background: transparent, opaque, auto. Transparent needs png/webp output.

tools.name: memory_get
tools.description: Safe exact excerpt read from MEMORY.md or memory/*.md. Defaults to a bounded excerpt when lines are omitted, includes truncation/continuation info when more content exists, and `corpus=wiki` reads from registered compiled-wiki supplements.

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Mandatory recall step: semantically search MEMORY.md + memory/*.md (and optional session transcripts) before answering questions about prior work, decisions, dates, people, preferences, or todos. Optional `corpus=wiki` or `corpus=all` also searches registered compiled-wiki supplements. `corpus=memory` restricts hits to indexed memory files (excludes session transcript chunks from ranking). `corpus=sessions` restricts hits to indexed session transcripts (same visibility rules as session history tools). If response has disabled=true, memory retrieval is unavailable and should be surfaced to the user.

tools.name: message
tools.description: Send/delete/manage channel messages. Supports actions: channel-info, channel-list, edit, list-pins, member-info, pin, react, reactions, read, send, thread-reply, unpin. Use action="read" with threadId to fetch prior messages in a thread when you need conversation context you do not have yet.

target.description: Recipient/channel: E.164 for WhatsApp/Signal, Telegram chat id/@username, Discord/Slack/Mattermost <channelId|user:ID|channel:ID>, or iMessage handle/chat_id

buffer.description: Base64 attachment payload; data URL ok.

forceDocument.description: Send image/GIF/video as document; avoids compression.

presentation.description: Rich message payload: text/buttons/selects/context. Unsupported blocks degrade to text.

messageId.description: Target message id for read/react/edit/delete/pin/unpin. Reaction-like defaults current inbound id when available.

message_id.description: snake_case alias of messageId; same defaults.

trackToolCalls.description: For current-message reaction, make reacted message the tool-progress reaction target.

tools.name: music_generate
tools.description: Create audio/music for song, jingle, beat, loop, soundtrack, anthem, instrumental requests. If user asks make/generate/create song/music, call music_generate; do not just write lyrics unless lyrics/text only. Prompt gets style/genre/mood/tempo/instruments/purpose. lyrics only exact sung words. Session chats: background task; do not call again for same request; wait completion, send attachments via message tool. "status" checks active task.

prompt.description: Music prompt: style, genre, mood, purpose.

lyrics.description: Exact sung lyrics only when the user supplies lyrics or asks for vocal words. For song/style requests, use prompt instead.

filename.description: Output filename hint; basename preserved in managed media dir.

tools.name: nodes
tools.description: Discover/control paired nodes: status, describe, pairing, notify, camera/photos/screen/location/notifications/invoke. Use file_fetch for files.

tools.name: pdf
tools.description: Analyze PDFs with model. Anthropic/Google native PDF when supported; else text/image extraction. Use pdf for one, pdfs for max 10; prompt says what to inspect.

tools.name: process
tools.description: Manage running exec sessions for commands already started: list, poll, log, write, send-keys, submit, paste, kill. Use poll/log when you need status, logs, quiet-success confirmation, or completion confirmation when automatic completion wake is unavailable. Use poll/log also for input-wait hints. Use write/send-keys/submit/paste/kill for input or intervention. Do not use process polling to emulate timers or reminders; use cron for scheduled follow-ups.

sessionId.description: Session id for actions other than list

keys.description: Key tokens to send for send-keys

hex.description: Hex bytes to send for send-keys

timeout.description: For poll: wait up to this many milliseconds before returning; max 30000 ms, higher values are clamped to 30000

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

tools.name: session_status
tools.description: Show /status-like card for current/visible session: model, usage, time, cost, tasks. Use `sessionKey="current"` for current session; UI labels like `openclaw-tui` are not keys. `model` sets session override; `model=default` resets. Use for active model/session config questions.

tools.name: sessions_history
tools.description: Fetch sanitized history for visible session. Use before replying, debugging, resuming; supports limits/tool messages.

tools.name: sessions_list
tools.description: List visible sessions; filter by kind, label, agentId, search, activity. Use before sessions_history or sessions_send target selection.

tools.name: sessions_send
tools.description: Send message to visible session by sessionKey/label, or configured agent by agentId. Thread-scoped chats rejected; target parent channel session. Creates missing configured-agent main session; waits for reply when available.

tools.name: sessions_spawn
tools.description: Spawn clean child session; default `runtime="subagent"`. `mode="run"` one-shot background work. Subagents inherit parent workspace. Native subagents get task in first visible `[Subagent Task]` message. Native only: `context="fork"` only when child needs current transcript; else omit or `isolated`. Use for fresh child-session work.

taskName.description: Stable alias for later targeting; lowercase letters/digits/underscores, starts letter.

context.description: Native context. Omit/"isolated" for clean child; "fork" only when child needs requester transcript.

tools.name: sessions_yield
tools.description: End current turn. Use after spawning subagents; results arrive as next message.

tools.name: subagents
tools.description: List/kill/steer spawned subagents for requester session. If sessions_yield exists, use it for completion; do not poll wait loops.

tools.name: tavily_extract
tools.description: Extract clean content from one or more URLs using Tavily. Handles JS-rendered pages. Supports query-focused chunking.

urls.description: One or more URLs to extract content from (max 20).

query.description: Rerank extracted chunks by relevance to this query.

include_images.description: Include image URLs in extraction results.

tools.name: tavily_search
tools.description: Search the web using Tavily Search API. Supports search depth, topic filtering, domain filters, time ranges, and AI answer summaries.

include_answer.description: Include an AI-generated answer summary (default: false).

include_domains.description: Only include results from these domains.

tools.name: tts
tools.description: Use only for explicit audio intent (voice/speech/TTS) or active TTS config. Never use for ordinary text replies. Audio auto-delivered from tool result; after success follow reply instructions, no duplicate text/audio.

tools.name: update_plan
tools.description: Update current run plan. Use for non-trivial multi-step work; keep plan current while executing. Short steps; max one `in_progress`; skip for simple one-step work.

tools.name: video_generate
tools.description: Create videos. Session chats: background task; do not call video_generate again for same request; wait completion, then send attachments via message tool. "status" checks active task. Duration may round to provider-supported value.

imageRoles.description: `image` + `images` roles by index after de-dupe. Values: first_frame, last_frame, reference_image; empty string leaves unset.

videoRoles.description: `video` + `videos` roles by index after de-dupe. Value: reference_video; empty string leaves unset.

filename.description: Output filename hint; basename preserved in managed media dir.

aspectRatio.description: Aspect ratio: 1:1, 16:9, 9:16, "adaptive", or provider value; unsupported normalized/ignored.

resolution.description: Resolution: 480P, 720P, 768P, 1080P, 4K, or provider value; unsupported normalized/ignored.

durationSeconds.description: Target seconds; may round to nearest supported duration.

providerOptions.description: Provider JSON options, e.g. {"seed":42}. Keys/types must match provider capabilities; mismatch skips candidate. Use action=list for accepted keys.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Fetch URL and extract readable markdown/text. Lightweight page access; no browser automation.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search web for current info; returns normalized provider results.

tools.name: write
tools.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

DianPage — history 是临时 state，刷新就没了 ```js const [history, setHistory] = useState([]); // 契印谱 ``` 落印后只存内存，**用户刷新页面就消失**。这页本质是"铸契"，丢了等于没铸。 **优化：** - 至少 localStorage 持久化 - 更好的：调用合约 `LicenseNFT.mint()`，从链上读 `getEvents(SealCast)` - 没接合约前，存 localStorage + 显示"待上链"标签 ### 6. JingCompPage — "上一轮/下一轮"是空操作 ```js ``` `setRound` 但**列表是写死的 RANKING**，`round` 没用。这功能等于不存在。 要么：接后端按 round 拉数据；要么：先删掉按钮，别让人点空气。 ### 7. PageWrapper — fade-in 在每次路由切换都重 mount ```js const [fade, setFade] = useState(false); useEffect(() => { setFade(true); return () => setFade(false); }, []); ``` 依赖空数组 → **只在挂载时执行一次**。路由切换时旧组件 unmount 新组件 mount，新组件还是从 `fade=false` 起步。所以动画**只在首次加载有效**，切页面反而没动画（因为 transition-all 300ms 也跑了，但确实是 false→true）。 要么依赖 `[location.pathname]`，要么用 framer-motion / react-transition-group 替代。 ### 9. # 文档速览：《势位之战 总白皮书 v0.2-v0.3》

**主笔：云子 | PM：雨娃 | Review：2026-06-03 10:00（v0.3 PM 定稿于 06-03 19:38-20:59）**

## 核心定位
- ECHO 协议上的**创作对战游戏**——不是 NFT 项目、不是协议，是「让谁用了谁的作品自动算清楚的物理法则」
- 视觉哲学：**骨头里长出来的水墨**，不是贴皮（"老匠斫木，不苟一丝，但留一丝天趣"）
- "用户永远可以选择只看画"——顶级技术是让人感受不到技术

## 六章结构

| 章节 | 主题 | 关键点 |
|:--:|:--|:--|
| 一 | 核心叙事 | 世界观、东方美学（克制/留白/有意境） |
| 二 | 美学系统 | **四权六档 × 年轮墨色**、**Shi-Graph 水域图**、纸感洇开、呼吸、意外之美 |
| 三 | 玩法架构 | 四权配置、**16 卦效果表**、对战流程 |

| 五 | 合约地址 | BattleGame v1.2: `0xEFB2912D...` · BattleRevenue v2.0: `0xd57806aF...` |
| 六 | 合规声明 | v0.3 新增，含 6.1-6.7 主文 + 6.8 Plan B 补充（待法律顾问） |

## 关键设计规范（影响前端）

**四权六档墨色系统：**
```
--shi-01-white:   #F5F0E8  宣纸水印（封印）
--shi-02-clear:   #D4CFC5  初现轮廓
--shi-03-light:   #A39E94  灰调过渡

--seal-hint:      #F0E8E0  封印水印
--break-edge:     #8B7355
```

**Shi-Graph 三层信息密度：**
- 第一层（气韵）：无交互，70% 留白
- 第二层（年轮）：悬停显四权六档
- 第三层（全貌）：点击显全部信息

**视觉档位归一化公式：** `visualTier = floor(semanticTier / semanticMax * 5)`

代码全看完了。现在我做一份有观点的诊断报告。 --- # ECHO v2 前端诊断报告 **整体判断：** 架构干净、风格统一（暖白 + 朱砂的传统视觉语言拿捏到位），但在**数据真实性、健壮性、性能、状态管理**四方面有明显可优化点。属于"看起来能跑、接真实链上数据会出问题"的阶段。 --- ## 🔴 必须修（影响功能/数据真实性） ### 1. DianPage / YuanPage / JingCompPage — 全是死数据 这三个页面**完全没有接后端**。 - `DianPage` 写死 `FOUR_SEALS`、configs、history 全部本地 state - `YuanPage` 写死 `WORKS`、`SOURCE_TREE`、纪年 - `JingCompPage` 写死 `RANKING`（势位榜）、`DERIVATIVES`（脉络） **问题：** 验收会上 4 个页面（境/典/源/竞），但只有**境（JingPage）真在拉后端**。其他三个是 demo 数据，演示完等于没做。 **优化方向：** - 沿用 JingPage 的 `useEffect + AbortController` 模式 - 在 `hooks/` 加 `useLicenses()`、`useRanking()`、`useSourceTree()` 三个数据 hook - 缺少的后端接口要催 Seaman_bot 出 ### 2. useWallet.js — chainChanged 处理有 bug ```js const handleChainChanged = () => { if (provider) refreshBalance(provider, address).catch(() => {}); }; ``` `address` 来自闭包——监听器注册时把当时的 `address` 写死了。**用户切完链，地址可能已经变了**。要么 removeAllListeners 重建，要么改用 ref 拿最新值。 更严重：监听器里**没重新创建 provider/signer**——切链后旧的 `signer` 还在用旧链的 RPC，后续合约调用会直接报错。 ### 3. JingPage 数据契约混乱 后端给的字段名和前端假设对不齐： - `potential` vs `potentialValue`（两处 if-else 兜底） - `phase` vs `shiPosition`（同一个意思多处不同名） - 触发条件 `nextPhaseTrigger` 类型可能是 string / number / object - 四权 `fourRights[right]` 也是同样问题 页面上到处是 `JSON.stringify(node.potential ?? null)` 这种防御性代码，**说明 schema 没锁**。应该和 Seaman_bot 出一个明确的 TypeScript types 或者 zod schema，放在 `contracts/types.js`。 --- ## 🟡 建议修（影响体验/可维护性） ### 4. JingPage 心电图 — D3 比裸 Canvas 性价比高 手写 Canvas 画心电图没问题，但 60+ 行的 imperative 代码： - 缩放/dpi 处理散落在 effect 里 - 没有 hover tooltip（点击节点看不到具体值） - 没有动画过渡（新数据点直接跳出来） **优化：** 用 `recharts` 或 `visx` 一两百行搞定，还自带响应式和 tooltip。当前实现**未来要加交互就要重写**。 ### 5. DianPage — history 是临时 state，刷新就没了 ```js const [history, setHistory] = useState([]); // 契印谱 ``` 落印后只存内存，**用户刷新页面就消失**。这页本质是"铸契"，丢了等于没铸。 **优化：** - 至少 localStorage 持久化 - 更好的：调用合约 `LicenseNFT.mint()`，从链上读 `getEvents(SealCast)` - 没接合约前，存 localStorage + 显示"待上链"标签 ### 6. JingCompPage — "上一轮/下一轮"是空操作 ```js ``` `setRound` 但**列表是写死的 RANKING**，`round` 没用。这功能等于不存在。 要么：接后端按 round 拉数据；要么：先删掉按钮，别让人点空气。 ### 7. App.jsx — NavLink 4 次几乎一样 ```jsx {({ isActive }) => (境)} // 典/源/竞 重复 3 遍 ``` 抽成数据驱动的 map： ```jsx const NAV = [{to:'/jing', label:'境'}, ...]; {NAV.map(n => {n.label})} ``` 省 20 行，未来加 nav 改一处。 ### 8. PageWrapper — fade-in 在每次路由切换都重 mount ```js const [fade, setFade] = useState(false); useEffect(() => { setFade(true); return () => setFade(false); }, []); ``` 依赖空数组 → **只在挂载时执行一次**。路由切换时旧组件 unmount 新组件 mount，新组件还是从 `fade=false` 起步。所以动画**只在首次加载有效**，切页面反而没动画（因为 transition-all 300ms 也跑了，但确实是 false→true）。 要么依赖 `[location.pathname]`，要么用 framer-motion / react-transition-group 替代。 ### 9. WalletBar — 重复 useEffect 算余额 ```js // useWallet.js const refreshBalance = ... // 已实现 // WalletBar.jsx useEffect(() => { if (!provider || !address) ... provider.getBalance(address).then(...) }, [provider, address]); // 又算一遍 ``` WalletBar 又写了一遍拉余额。直接 `useWalletContext().balance` 就行。 ### 10. 颜色不一致 — tailwind 配的色没人用 `tailwind.config.js` 配了 `cream/ink/muted/coral/sage/amber/emerald` 一套完整色板，**代码里几乎没人用**。全在用 `bg-[#faf9f7]` `text-[#2D2A26]` 这种硬编码 hex。 **优化：** - 一旦主题色要改（比如老板觉得朱砂太重），硬编码改 50+ 处 - 改用 `bg-cream text-ink` 语义化，IDE 有提示 - 配的 emerald `#6B9E87` 跟 nav 下划线一致，但代码用 `bg-[#6B9E87]` 直接硬写 --- ## 🟢 小优化（锦上添花） ### 11. useCase.js — `processingRef` 保护了 setLoading 但保护错了东西 ```js if (processingRef.current) return; processingRef.current = true; ``` 这个 ref 防的是**同一 hook 实例**并发调用。问题是 `useCase` 每次组件渲染都创建新函数，但 ref 是闭包内的——其实 OK。但是 `signer` 变化时 useCallback 重建函数，ref 状态会变。要么用 useRef 在 hook 顶部、要么写在更外层（自定义 hook 实例稳定）。 更根本：**这是 `disabled` 应该做的事**，按钮加 `disabled={loading}` 就够。 ### 12. ErrorBoundary 没有 reset 机制 ```js if (this.state.hasError) { return
...
; } ``` 刷新太重了。应该 `this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null })` 提供"恢复"按钮。 ### 13. Index.html / SEO / 加载态 没看 `index.html` 估计没设 ``/`<meta>`/OG 标签。如果部署到 Cloudflare Pages 公网演示，**SEO 和分享卡片是空白**。建议加： ```html <title>ECHO — 势位如川 ``` --- ## 🏗️ 架构层建议（动结构） ### 14. 缺一个全局数据层 现在 JingPage 拉了 `/api/potential` 但只在组件内 state——切到其他页再切回来又重新请求。 **建议：** 用 React Query / SWR，或者至少 `contexts/DataContext.jsx` 把后端数据提升到 Provider 层，缓存 + 共享。 ### 15. 错误处理没有统一 - JingPage 自己 try/catch + 8s 超时 - useCase / useWallet 各自 setError - UI 层都没消费 `error` state 显示 应该建 `components/ErrorToast.jsx` + 全局 ErrorContext 统一处理。 ### 16. 后端地址硬编码 `JingPage` 里 `const API_BASE = 'https://echo-api.meerfans.club'`，应该走 env：`import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE`。 （注：之前 GitHub PAT 失效时也提到这个迁移问题，根因之一就是配置散落。） --- ## 优先级排序 | 优先级 | 项目 | 工时 | 价值 | |:--:|:--|:--:|:--| | P0 | 1. 死数据三个页面 | 半天 | 验收通过 | | P0 | 3. 锁 schema | 1h | 后续不返工 | | P1 | 2. useWallet 切链 bug | 30min | 切链就崩 | | P1 | 16. API_BASE 走 env | 10min | 防止再迁移 | | P1 | 5. DianPage history 持久化 | 30min | demo 不丢数据 | | P2 | 6. JingComp 假按钮 | 5min | 不骗自己 | | P2 | 7-10. 重构清理 | 1h | 可维护 | | P3 | 4. 心电图换库 | 2h | 未来扩展 | **我的建议：** 1. 先把 P0+P1 做了，这堆代码才"真能用" 2. 然后约猫先森 / Seaman_bot 锁 schema，开 1.1 数据接口 3. 重构可以排到下个迭代 要我现在动手改哪几个？还是先开会拉齐接口？

# 文档速览：《势位之战 总白皮书 v0.2-v0.3》

**主笔：云子 | PM：雨娃 | Review：2026-06-03 10:00（v0.3 PM 定稿于 06-03 19:38-20:59）**

## 核心定位
- ECHO 协议上的**创作对战游戏**——不是 NFT 项目、不是协议，是「让谁用了谁的作品自动算清楚的物理法则」
- 视觉哲学：**骨头里长出来的水墨**，不是贴皮（"老匠斫木，不苟一丝，但留一丝天趣"）
- "用户永远可以选择只看画"——顶级技术是让人感受不到技术

## 六章结构

| 章节 | 主题 | 关键点 |
|:--:|:--|:--|
| 一 | 核心叙事 | 世界观、东方美学（克制/留白/有意境） |
| 二 | 美学系统 | **四权六档 × 年轮墨色**、**Shi-Graph 水域图**、纸感洇开、呼吸、意外之美 |
| 三 | 玩法架构 | 四权配置、**16 卦效果表**、对战流程 |
| 四 | 经济模型 | **45/25/10/20 分账**（创作者 45 含 8% 开发者激励 / 编排者 25 / 平台 10 / 赢家池 20） |
| 五 | 合约地址 | BattleGame v1.2: `0xEFB2912D...` · BattleRevenue v2.0: `0xd57806aF...` |
| 六 | 合规声明 | v0.3 新增，含 6.1-6.7 主文 + 6.8 Plan B 补充（待法律顾问） |

## 关键设计规范（影响前端）

**四权六档墨色系统：**
```
--shi-01-white:   #F5F0E8  宣纸水印（封印）
--shi-02-clear:   #D4CFC5  初现轮廓
--shi-03-light:   #A39E94  灰调过渡
--shi-04-heavy:   #6B665C  沉稳
--shi-05-thick:   #3D3830  浓墨重彩
--shi-06-burnt:   #1A1814  焦墨枯笔（破界）
--paper-bg:       #F7F4ED
--cold-base:      #2A2A2A  灰色磨砂冷底（数字骨骼）
--seal-hint:      #F0E8E0  封印水印
--break-edge:     #8B7355
```

**Shi-Graph 三层信息密度：**
- 第一层（气韵）：无交互，70% 留白
- 第二层（年轮）：悬停显四权六档
- 第三层（全貌）：点击显全部信息

**视觉档位归一化公式：** `visualTier = floor(semanticTier / semanticMax * 5)`
- Usage/Derive/Expand：0-5
- Benefit：0-2

## 经济参数定稿（雨娃 19:38）
- 分账：**45 / 25 / 10 / 20**
- 软顶：10,000 MEER
- 16 卦 MVP 数据：猫先森 20:52 推到 `echo-v2/docs/economic-model-split-v0.1.json`

## 我现在的项目状态
- 之前一直在做的 `outputs/echo-v2/` 是**协议可视化前端**（境/典/源/竞四页）——和这白皮书是配套的，**但白皮书指向的是一个全新的对战游戏前端**
- 白皮书提到的"势位之战"应该是要在 `echo-v2` 基础上做的**下一层应用**

1. **基于这份白皮书做新项目** —— 在 `echo-v2` 之上起一个 `outputs/echo-battle/` 目录，按四权六档、Shi-Graph、16 卦做对战游戏前端
2. **把白皮书落进现有代码** —— 把四权六档 CSS 变量 / 归一化公式 / 分账比例同步进 `echo-v2` 的 tailwind config 和 types.js
3. **只是让我读一下** —— 给老板梳理重点
4. **其他** —— 你说
